title: IPVS mode no longer sets route_localnet

detection.reason: read from the kube-proxy ConfigMap's own mode field, which the agent extracts as a single token; a mode passed only as a --proxy-mode container arg is not read here

quote: Kube-proxy's IPVS proxy mode no longer sets the net.ipv4.conf.all.route_localnet sysctl parameter. Nodes upgrading will have net.ipv4.conf.all.route_localnet set to 1 but new nodes will inherit the system default (usually 0).
remediation: Only nodes JOINED after the upgrade inherit the system default. Existing nodes keep route_localnet=1, so the breakage appears gradually as nodes are replaced. If anything depends on it (NodePort traffic to 127.0.0.1 is the usual case), set the sysctl explicitly in your node image or a privileged init DaemonSet before rolling nodes.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get cm -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | startswith("kube-proxy")) | (.data // {}) | to_entries[] | .value | scan("(?m)^ *mode: *\"?([a-z]+)") | .[0]'  # prints the configured kube-proxy mode; ipvs means this note applies to this cluster

title: --cleanup-ipvs flag removed

detection.reason: container args only — a flag set through a config file or an env var is not scanned

quote: remove deprecated --cleanup-ipvs flag of kube-proxy, and make --cleanup flag always to flush IPVS
remediation: Drop `--cleanup-ipvs` from the kube-proxy DaemonSet. `--cleanup` now always flushes IPVS, so the behaviour you wanted is what you get by default; kube-proxy fails to start on an unknown flag.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get ds -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select([.spec.template.spec.containers[].args[]?] | any(test("--cleanup-ipvs"))) | .metadata.name'  # each DaemonSet printed still passes a flag removed in 1.21
